changes: Export fragment source for build-time GLSL-to-WGSL translation.
Expose interactive render, clock reset and finish-reveal preview for a shared RAF; glass equations preserved.
Expose canvas-frame invalidation matching the native rain/video update path.
AttentionAwareness SVG unchanged; component memoizes its innerHTML object. All v5 modes use the same larger illustration box, without foreground labels.
v5 rain uses bundled Noto JP fallback instead of OS fonts and uncapped active delta so slow frames do not change animation speed; seek added for visual QA.
Full Rust v5 uses GPU rain, tessellated original SVG paths, stencil occlusion, cached original-path glow and MSAA4. Main figures are not raster sprites.
